mapper.select: SELECT * FROM user_progress WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND unit_id = #{unitId}
SELECT * FROM user_progress WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND path_id = #{pathId}
SELECT * FROM user_progress WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY start_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_progress (user_id, unit_id, path_id, status, start_time, last_study_time, study_duration, visit_count, rating, is_favorite) VALUES (#{userId}, #{unitId}, #{pathId}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW(), #{studyDuration}, 1, #{rating}, #{isFavorite})

INSERT INTO user_progress (user_id, unit_id, path_id, status, start_time, last_study_time, study_duration, visit_count, rating, is_favorite) VALUES (#{userId}, #{unitId}, #{pathId}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW(), #{studyDuration}, 1, 0, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE user_progress SET status = #{status}, start_time = #{startTime}, complete_time = #{completeTime}, last_study_time = #{lastStudyTime}, study_duration = #{studyDuration} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_progress WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND path_id = #{pathId} AND status = 'COMPLETED'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_progress WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND unit_id = #{unitId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_progress WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT * FROM user_progress WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY start_time DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM user_progress WHERE unit_id = #{unitId} AND start_time >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INTERVAL #{hours} HOUR)

SELECT u.id AS userId, u.username, u.avatar, p.start_time AS lastVisitTime FROM user_progress p JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.id WHERE p.unit_id = #{unitId} AND p.start_time >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INTERVAL #{hours} HOUR) GROUP BY p.user_id ORDER BY p.start_time DESC LIMIT 12
SELECT rating FROM user_progress WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND unit_id = #{unitId}
SELECT is_favorite FROM user_progress WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND unit_id = #{unitId}

SELECT lp.title, COUNT(DISTINCT p.user_id) AS user_count FROM learning_paths lp LEFT JOIN user_progress p ON lp.id = p.path_id WHERE lp.status = 'PUBLISHED' GROUP BY lp.id, lp.title ORDER BY user_count DESC

SELECT DATE(last_study_time) AS study_date, COALESCE(SUM(study_duration), 0) AS total_duration FROM user_progress WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND last_study_time >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL 6 DAY) AND last_study_time <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP GROUP BY DATE(last_study_time) ORDER BY study_date ASC

SELECT DATE(last_study_time) AS study_date, COUNT(*) AS study_count FROM user_progress WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND last_study_time >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL 6 DAY) AND last_study_time <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP GROUP BY DATE(last_study_time) ORDER BY study_date ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_progress WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'COMPLETED'
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(visit_count), 0) FROM user_progress WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(study_duration), 0) FROM user_progress WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT path_id) FROM user_progress WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND path_id IS NOT NULL AND path_id > 0 AND status = 'COMPLETED'

SELECT DATE(last_study_time) AS activity_date, COUNT(*) AS activity_count FROM user_progress WHERE last_study_time >= #{startDate} AND last_study_time < #{endDate} GROUP BY DATE(last_study_time) ORDER BY activity_date ASC
